insight: Snyk Code is built on DeepCode AI, the symbolic+ML engine from its 2020 DeepCode buy, trained on millions of data-flow cases, not an LLM.
name: Snyk
tagline: Developer security platform with DeepCode AI for SAST, SCA, and AI-generated fixes.
description: Snyk finds and fixes vulnerabilities in code, open-source dependencies, containers, and IaC. Its Snyk Code SAST engine, DeepCode AI, combines symbolic and machine-learning analysis with inter-file data-flow tracing to detect issues and auto-generate fixes. Integrates into IDEs, the CLI, and CI.

modelSupport.notes: DeepCode AI engine is proprietary; not a BYO-key LLM wrapper.
